clue.text: To the best of my knowledge, that could be the horizon

definitions.text: To the best of my knowledge
definitions.meaning: an everyday phrase meaning 'so far as I know'
read literally, the limit of one's view is the line where earth meets sky

explanation.surface: Someone hedges a claim, then muses about the distant skyline.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for 'as far as I know', and taken literally it names the farthest point visible, which is the horizon.

clue.text: Longed to be praised, though wicked

indicators.note: wicked suggests something twisted out of its proper form, so the letters of praised are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone yearned for compliments despite being a villain.
explanation.definitionFit: To aspire is to yearn or hope strongly, the same as having longed.

clue.text: Innovators with a combination of foresight and fun

indicators.note: a combination mixes things together, so the letters of these three words are blended into a new order

explanation.surface: Pioneers who blend vision with enjoyment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a combination of' rearranges all fifteen letters of FORESIGHT AND FUN, the 'and' included.
explanation.definitionFit: Founding fathers are the originators who set something up, people who brought in new things.

clue.text: Reckless contact with nettle can bring this

definitions.meaning: acting without thought of consequences, hasty

definitions.text: contact with nettle can bring this
definitions.meaning: brushing a stinging nettle raises an itchy skin eruption

explanation.surface: A careless brush against a stinging plant brings its own reward.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is impetuous or hasty; the other is a skin eruption, the red bumps a nettle sting causes.

clue.text: Lovers in farm wagon in the middle of Sussex

indicators.note: the farm wagon is placed in, between the letters picked from Sussex
the middle of a six-letter word is its central pair of letters

parts.note: a wain is an old word for a farm wagon or cart

explanation.surface: Courting couples ride in a hay cart through the English countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: Sussex is a county in southern England; its central pair of letters form the outside of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A swain is a poetic word for a young male suitor or admirer.

clue.text: Character at home with gangster is church dignitary

parts.note: a card is an eccentric or amusing character
in means at home, as in 'staying in'
Al Capone is the archetypal gangster, so Al stands for one

explanation.surface: A colourful personality living with a mobster turns out to be a senior cleric.
explanation.definitionFit: A cardinal is a senior Roman Catholic prelate, ranking just below the Pope.

clue.text: Troublesome insect near fruit

indicators.note: something troublesome is unruly, so the letters of insect near are put into disorder

explanation.surface: An annoying bug is hovering close to the fruit bowl.
explanation.definitionFit: A nectarine is a smooth-skinned variety of peach, a stone fruit.

clue.text: Plant improves — green in spring

indicators.note: to spring is to leap about, so the letters of improves green in jump into new places

explanation.surface: A gardener notes that a plant brightens with spring growth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spring' rearranges IMPROVES GREEN IN; 'in' is part of the fodder, not a container.
explanation.definitionFit: The evening primrose is a flowering plant whose yellow blooms open at dusk.

clue.text: A time's taken by one getting right?

definitions.text: A time's taken by one getting right?

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone spends a while trying to put matters right.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces A, T, ONE, R simply follow one another; the whole clue also describes the answer, a person making amends over time.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who atones makes amends for a wrong, setting things right.

clue.text: President leading existing country or former one

indicators.note: leading means the president's letter goes in front of the other piece

parts.note: Russia is a country that exists today

explanation.surface: A head of state heads a nation, past or present.
explanation.definitionFit: Prussia was a German kingdom and state, abolished in 1947, so it is a country of the past.

clue.text: Most opulent king, one with box of treasure?

parts.note: R stands for Rex, Latin for king
I is the Roman numeral for one
a treasure chest is a box of riches

explanation.surface: The wealthiest monarch keeps a trunk full of gold.
explanation.definitionFit: Richest is the superlative of rich, meaning the most wealthy or luxurious.

clue.text: Bad-mannered game, side having half its members sent off

parts.note: RU stands for Rugby Union

indicators.text: having half its members sent off
indicators.note: the word side loses half its letters, the first two, like players dismissed from a team

explanation.surface: A rugby team behaves so badly that half its players are dismissed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having half its members sent off' removes SI from SIDE, leaving DE.
explanation.definitionFit: Rude means impolite or showing bad manners.

clue.text: Mark in style of speaking to hold audience primarily

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the style of speaking holds, wraps around, the letter taken from audience

parts.note: diction is a person's manner of enunciation

indicators.note: primarily means first, so only the opening letter of audience is used

explanation.surface: A speaker's elocution is judged by how well it holds the listeners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is not a container signal here; it supplies its own two letters at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: An indication is a sign or token, just as a mark can be a sign of something.

clue.text: Child with untidy room — a certain thing to do with genetics!

indicators.note: an untidy room is messed up, so the letters of room are jumbled

parts.note: some can mean a certain, as in 'some person called'

explanation.surface: A child's messy bedroom is blamed on their genes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a certain' stands for a vague determiner, as in 'some fellow rang'; the exclamation mark flags the joke of blaming genes for a messy bedroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A chromosome is the thread-like structure in a cell that carries genes.

clue.text: It's hard getting into grimy boat

indicators.note: the letter for hard gets into, goes inside, the word for grimy

parts.note: dingy means dirty or drab
H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: It is tough clambering aboard a filthy little vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A dinghy is a small open sailing or rowing vessel.

clue.text: Hang around by mum and keep off school when well?

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother
to linger is to stay about, loiter

explanation.surface: A child dawdles beside their mother, skipping school while perfectly healthy.
explanation.definitionFit: To malinger is to feign illness to avoid work or duty, here pretending to be ill to miss lessons.

clue.text: People coming round after 6 rest or start to sleep

indicators.note: after means the pieces that follow come after the numeral

parts.note: VI is the Roman numeral for six
to sit is to rest
taken as written

indicators.note: the start of a word is its opening letter, so sleep gives just its first

explanation.surface: Guests drop in after six o'clock, to relax or to nod off.
explanation.walkthrough: '6' is the number, not a cross-reference; 'start to' takes S from sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: Visitors are callers or guests, those who come to see someone at home.

clue.text: One of those with a trumpet heralding spring

definitions.text: One of those with a trumpet heralding spring

parts.words: One of those with a trumpet heralding spring
parts.note: reads like a fanfare player announcing the season, but describes a yellow flower whose central cup is called a trumpet and which blooms early in the year

explanation.definitionFit: This flower has a trumpet-shaped corona and is a traditional sign that the warm season is coming.

clue.text: Discussion to be put back in time

indicators.note: the reversed word is placed in the word for time

parts.note: a date is a point in time

indicators.note: put back means the word be is turned round and read backwards

explanation.surface: A meeting is postponed to a later date.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is only a link; 'put back' turns the little word round before it goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A debate is a formal argument or exchange of views.

clue.text: Suit for Scottish team

definitions.meaning: one of the four sets in a pack of playing cards
the Edinburgh football club Heart of Midlothian, known by a shortened nickname

explanation.surface: Picking a card suit to represent a football club from Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: Heart of Midlothian is a Scottish Premiership football club from Edinburgh.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a card suit marked with red symbols; the other is the nickname of an Edinburgh football club.

clue.text: Governors allowing armed rescuers to surround prison

indicators.note: the letters for the armed rescuers go around the word for prison

parts.note: the SAS, Special Air Service, is the British army's special forces regiment, used in hostage rescues
a trap is something that confines, a place one cannot escape

explanation.surface: Officials let soldiers besiege a jail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'allowing' is only a link. The SAS famously rescued hostages in the 1980 Iranian Embassy siege in London.
explanation.definitionFit: A satrap was a provincial governor in ancient Persia, and now any petty ruler.

clue.text: Sports contestant who may be foiled

definitions.text: Sports contestant who may be foiled

parts.words: Sports contestant who may be foiled
parts.note: foiled seems to mean thwarted, but here means armed with a foil, the light sword used in one sporting discipline

explanation.definitionFit: A swordsman in the Olympic sport wields a foil, épée or sabre.

clue.text: Order for boy to be washed — one to get crumby?

definitions.text: Order for boy to be washed
definitions.meaning: a command telling someone to wash a lad of a certain first name
a biscuit, which leaves crumbs when eaten

explanation.surface: A parent orders a son into the tub, while someone else munches a crumbly snack.
explanation.walkthrough: A Bath Oliver is a plain dry biscuit, a British teatime classic invented in the spa city of Bath.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase reads as an instruction to wash a lad named Oliver, and is also the name of a dry biscuit that leaves crumbs.

clue.text: Issue of American magazine sent back

indicators.note: sent back means the magazine's name is read in reverse

parts.note: Time is a well-known American news weekly

explanation.surface: An edition of a US periodical is returned to the publisher.
explanation.definitionFit: To emit is to send out or give off, the verb sense of issue.

clue.text: Stay for the end of worship

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter, here from worship

explanation.surface: Someone remains until the service is over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the end of' takes P from worship.
explanation.definitionFit: A stay is a support or brace, and a prop does the same job.

clue.text: Musical effect from rapid sort of movement in vibrating tool

indicators.note: the movement letters go in among the rearranged letters of tool
something vibrating shakes about, so the letters of tool are shaken into a new order

parts.note: REM is rapid eye movement, the sleep phase

explanation.surface: A buzzing power tool creates a wavering sound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vibrating' gives TOLO, the shuffled letters of tool; 'rapid sort of movement' points to sleep science, not speed in general.
explanation.definitionFit: A tremolo is a wavering effect made by rapidly repeating a note or varying its volume.

clue.text: Gosh — a person brought back south American money!

parts.note: cor is a British exclamation of surprise, like gosh

indicators.note: brought back means these two pieces are read in reverse order

parts.note: bod is British slang for a person

explanation.surface: An exclamation of surprise as someone returns with foreign cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought back' reverses A BOD into DOBA.
explanation.definitionFit: The córdoba is the currency of Nicaragua, a Latin American country.

clue.text: When groups meet holiday-makers, they try to make a quick buck

definitions.text: they try to make a quick buck

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
sets are groups or collections
trippers are people on an outing or holiday

explanation.surface: Tour parties meet tourists and try to earn money fast.
explanation.definitionFit: Asset strippers buy firms and sell off their parts for a fast profit.
